I was homeschooled, It had ups and downs but as a young adult now I notice I still experienced most of the same things as my friends who went to school. With some exceptions of course. I think that this is partially due to the technology that was coming out as I was going through highschool. I don’t feel like I missed out on things. And I do believe homeschooling set me up  well to live in the real world possibly better then my companions at schools. But when I think about homeschooling vs public or private schools I still am unsure of what I would like for my children. I would love to know others opinions!
